title: Project Manager
summary: Keeps projects moving and visible: prepares agendas, turns meeting notes into decisions and action items with owners and dates, keeps the action tracker, and writes status reports that lead with blockers.
_gcp_roles_comment: None beyond the generic base set. Docs, Sheets and Calendar are reached as the agent's own Google Workspace account through domain-wide delegation, which needs no Google Cloud role on the project.
_setup_comment: No packages beyond the generic role's.
